name: explainium
description: Create silent animated explainer videos from a chat: Explainium composes the scenes, shows previews in the conversation, and opens every video in its studio to watch, edit and export.

interface.longDescription:
Explainium turns an idea, a topic, a blog post or your release notes into a short animated explainer video, right from the chat. It works in plain ChatGPT on desktop or on your phone, so you can make a video on the go.

Describe what the video should explain and who it is for. Explainium composes the scenes from motion-graphics building blocks: kinetic typography, diagrams, charts, icons and photos, timed to a musical beat grid. The videos are silent by design, so every scene reads on mute.

As it works, Explainium checks preview frames of each scene. Ask for changes in plain words (a different headline, a slower reveal, another color, an extra scene) and it revises the video in place.

Use your own images and video clips: upload them in the Explainium Studio first, then ask for a video that uses them. Explainium can also add images and clips from a public link, or search a stock library of icons, photos and clips.

Every video opens in the Explainium Studio at go.explainium.com, where you can watch it, fine-tune text and assets, and download it as an MP4. You can also ask for the MP4 from the chat.

Good for explainers, how-tos, product updates and feature launches, lesson intros, announcements, social posts and concept walkthroughs, in landscape, square or vertical formats.
capabilities: Use your own uploaded images and videos
Add images, icons and stock media
defaultPrompt: Turn this blog post into a short animated explainer video
Turn these release notes into a 30-second product update video
Make a 30-second explainer video about how coffee gets from the farm to your cup

positive.description: Create a new landscape explainer video from a topic
positive.prompt: Use Explainium to make a 20-second explainer video titled "How Photosynthesis Works".
positive.tools_triggered: get_authoring_rules, get_library_menu, create_project, get_animation, update_animation, preview_animation
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new 1920x1080 project named How Photosynthesis Works, saves an animation of several scenes about photosynthesis, previews its frames to check them, and gives the link https://go.explainium.com/movie/<projectId> where the video plays.

positive.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 Explainium video announcing a sourdough baking class this Saturday at 10am.
positive.tools_triggered: get_authoring_rules, get_library_menu, create_project, get_animation, update_animation, preview_animation
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new 1080x1920 project, saves an animation that announces the class with its day and time, previews its frames, and gives the movie link. It does not export an MP4 unless asked.

positive.prompt: In my Explainium video How Photosynthesis Works, change the opening headline to "Sunlight into Sugar".
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the How Photosynthesis Works project, changes the opening scene's headline to Sunlight into Sugar with a targeted edit that leaves the rest of the video unchanged, and confirms the change with the movie link.

positive.description: Add a stock photo to a video
positive.prompt: Add a stock photo of a green forest to the opening scene of my Explainium video How Photosynthesis Works.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the stock library for forest photos, adds one to the project, places it in the opening scene while keeping the other scenes unchanged, and confirms which photo it used.

positive.prompt: Export my Explainium video How Photosynthesis Works as a 1080p MP4.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a 1080p export of the How Photosynthesis Works project, checks its status until it is ready, and gives a download link for the MP4 (valid for one hour).

negative.prompt: Write a short email to my team moving Friday's meeting to 3pm.
Generate a photorealistic picture of a cat in a space suit.
What is the capital of Australia?

publication.release_notes: First release: create, preview, revise and export silent animated explainer videos from the chat.
